# 2025_Q193

## Question

Type of knot shown, commonly used in surgical procedures?

## Options

- A) Surgeon's knot ✅
- B) Granny's knot
- C) Square knot
- D) Slip knot

## Your Answer

C) Square knot

## Correct Answer

A) Surgeon's knot

## Key Fact (generated by LLM)

A surgeon's knot is a type of knot used in surgical procedures, characterized by an extra turn of the thread around the standing part, providing extra security. It is commonly used to ligate vessels or tie sutures. The mechanism involves a double wrap of the thread around the standing part, which enhances knot security. 

## Why You Got It Wrong (generated by LLM)

The student incorrectly chose square knot, which, although similar, does not have the extra turn that provides added security.
